test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If a = 17,b = 13, then find the value of the expression (a³ - b³ - 3a²b + 3ab²).
solution:
**Formula used**

(a - b)³ = a3 - b3 - 3a2b + 3ab2

**Calculation**

(a - b)3 = a3 - b3 - 3a2b + 3ab2

⇒ (17 - 13)3 = a3 - b3 - 3a2b + 3ab2

⇒ (4)3 = a3 - b3 - 3a2b + 3ab2

⇒ 64 = a3 - b3 - 3a2b + 3ab2

**The value is 64.**
